_comment: Which families a board actually runs. Getting this wrong writes one firmware at a board expecting another - a cartographer probe flashed with upstream klipper, or judged against a source tree it was never built from - so every step from reading the key to acting on it is guarded.

mutations.name: families() returns exactly what a type declares
the declared firmware list is kept, not discarded on load
a family nobody declared is refused rather than accepted
a non-default firmware list survives a save
the application is the first declared family that is not a bootloader
the bootloader is the first declared family that is one
